titles.title: Daggerfall
titles.engine: Bethesda XnGine, DOS: FALL.EXE ('TES: Daggerfall v1.07.', GOG build), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74-2.1 (DOSBOX\DOSBox.exe md5 2318a446...)
titles.launch_sets: Play Daggerfall.bat runs call FLEETRES.BAT, then FLEETRES.EXE -ini dosbox_daggerfall.conf sdl fullresolution %FR_DOSFULLRES% ('desktop' on an EDID LCD), then DOSBox.exe -conf ..\dosbox_daggerfall.conf -conf ..\dosbox_daggerfall_fleet.conf. The second conf is [autoexec] only, so it cannot override [sdl]. The GAMERES rule at agent/shared/gameres.h:797 writes the same key at sync. The deployed conf on .123/.145/.195/.240 (downloaded 2026-09-29 00:12) reads fullresolution=desktop, output=overlay, aspect=true. DOSBox therefore keeps the 1920x1080 desktop and scales the game's 320x200 image to a 1440x1080 pillarbox. The mechanism is present and correct, but nobody has seen it on an LCD: the compat DB has render rows only for the .133/.143 CRTs (640x480, 2026-09-01).
titles.menu_source: There is no resolution option anywhere. FALL.EXE is a 320x200 VGA renderer. Z.CFG (the file FALL.EXE takes as argv[1]) holds only type/path/pathCD/map keys. SETUP.EXE/SETUP.INI is the HMI sound setup. The game's own options have no video-mode item. The only scaling control is DOSBox's, and that is outside the game.
titles.evidence: Staged tree /mnt/retro-share/Files/Games-Library/Daggerfall: 'Play Daggerfall.bat' (FLEETRES -ini line); dosbox_daggerfall.conf [sdl] fullscreen=true, fullresolution=desktop (staged literal), output=overlay; [render] aspect=true, scaler=normal2x; [dosbox] machine=svga_s3. Z.CFG: 'type dfall_huge / path C:\arena2\'. Binary: FALL.EXE contains 'TES: Daggerfall v1.07.'. DOSBox 0.74-2.1 VESA table, parsed from the binary: largest mode 0x107 1280x1024, no 1920x1080. FLEETRES.BAT md5 23edd351 and FLEETRES.EXE md5 bb180f3b are the same in all 41 titles, and the EXE matches provisioning/fleetres/FLEETRES.EXE. Evidence: .claude/evidence-1080p/survey-dosbox-descent-carma/boxes/<ip>_Daggerfall__dosbox_daggerfall.conf, static/dosbox074-vesa-mode-table.txt, static/binary-strings.txt
titles.fix: None needed. For a 320x200 DOS title the right 1080p answer is DOSBox fullresolution=desktop plus aspect=true, and that is already deployed. Native 1080p rendering would mean Daggerfall Unity, which is a different engine (Unity), is not on the share (searched case-insensitively), and cannot run on the XP boxes.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: FLEETRES.BAT/EXE and the launcher line generated by scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (entry 'Daggerfall'), plus the GAMERES rule in agent/shared/gameres.h.
titles.hw_check: On .145 (XP, the only LCD box never measured): EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Daggerfall" "Play Daggerfall.bat". Wait about 45 s for the Bethesda intro and the Load/New/Exit menu. DISPLAYCFG get must still read 1920x1080 (no mode switch). SCREENSHOT 0: the non-black area should be about 1440x1080 at x=240..1680. Then taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe" and confirm the desktop is 1920x1080. There is no resolution menu to navigate. Daggerfall's own menus are mouse-driven inside DOSBox and are not needed for this check.
titles.verifier_notes: The staged literal fullresolution=desktop is irrelevant: the launcher rewrites it on every start and GAMERES on every sync. Its [autoexec] lives only in dosbox_daggerfall_fleet.conf, because GOG's _single.conf blocks on choice /c1234.

titles.title: Carmageddon1
titles.engine: BRender, DOS/4GW MAINPROG.EXE (GOG), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 (md5 33294e0a...)
titles.launch_sets: All four launchers (Play, Sound Setup, Host LAN, Join LAN) write fullresolution=%FR_DOSFULLRES% into dosboxCarma.conf, which is passed first. dosboxCarma_single/_lan/_settings.conf and _ipxhost.conf contain only [IPX]/[autoexec]. The GAMERES rule is at gameres.h:793. dosboxCarma_single.conf runs 'MAINPROG.EXE -runme -hires', which is 640x480x8 VESA. The deployed dosboxCarma.conf on all four LCD boxes reads desktop/overlay/aspect=true, so the 640x480 image is scaled to a 1440x1080 pillarbox inside the 1920x1080 desktop. On 08-31 the compat rows read 'dosbox 1920x1080' on .123/.240/.246, and the .240 capture's content was 1440 px wide. Present and correct.
titles.menu_source: The game has no in-game resolution option. The mode is chosen only by command-line switch. MAINPROG.EXE's switch list is -deckchairs -hires -lomem -nocutscenes -runme -simple -sound -spamfritter -yon. Its only SVGA mode string is 'VESA,W:640,H:480,B:8'. Graphics data exist only as DATA\32X20X8 (320x200) and DATA\64X48X8 (640x480). The in-game Graphics options are detail toggles.
titles.evidence: Staged: Play Carmageddon.bat (FLEETRES -ini dosboxCarma.conf); dosboxCarma.conf [sdl] fullresolution=original (staged literal, rewritten per box), output=overlay; [render] aspect=true; machine=svga_s3. dosboxCarma_single.conf: 'MAINPROG.EXE -runme -hires'. Strings in MAINPROG.EXE: 'VESA,W:640,H:480,B:8', '-hires'. Evidence: boxes/<ip>_Carmageddon1__dosboxCarma.conf, prior-0831/240_Carmageddon1_Play_Carmageddon.png, static/binary-strings.txt, static/dosbox074-vesa-mode-table.txt (DOSBox 0.74's largest VESA mode is 1280x1024).
titles.fix: None needed. 640x480 (-hires) is this engine's ceiling and is already used, and DOSBox desktop plus aspect=true gives the correct 1080p presentation. Native high resolution would need a different engine, such as the 'dethrace' reimplementation. It is not on the share and its XP support is unknown.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: stage-fleetres.py entry 'Carmageddon1' and GAMERES rule gameres.h:793.
titles.hw_check: On .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Carmageddon1" "Play Carmageddon.bat". The intro FMV runs about 2 minutes and is scaled the same way. DISPLAYCFG get must stay 1920x1080. SCREENSHOT 0 should show content inside x=240..1680 at full height. Then taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe" and check the desktop mode. The front end is keyboard-navigable (arrows/Enter) but has no resolution item to show.

titles.title: Carmageddon2
titles.engine: BRender Win32, CARMA2_HW.EXE v1.02a, Glide renderer (install.reg Driver=2) through the game-local nGlide 1.02 (glide2x.dll 1,310,720 B, which wraps Glide to Direct3D 9)
titles.launch_sets: Play Carmageddon 2.bat calls FLEETRES.BAT but uses only FR_GLIDE, to move nGlide aside on boxes with a real 3dfx card. It writes no resolution, and gameres.h has no rule for this title. On the 1080p boxes nGlide stays in place. HKCU\Software\Zeus Software\nGlide does not exist on .123/.145/.195/.240 (REGREAD 2026-09-29), so nGlide runs at its default 'By app', which is the game's own 640x480. The display switches to 640x480 fullscreen and the GPU or monitor scaler stretches it to the panel. Measured on 08-31: compat rows 640x480 on .123/.240/.246, and those screenshots are 640x480.
titles.menu_source: Carmageddon 2 has no resolution setting. Graphics data exist only for 320x200 (data\32X20X8) and 640x480 (data\64x48x8). CARMA2_HW.EXE contains '640x480 init string', '320x200 init string' and 'Screen width/height doesn't match graf data'. Its switches are only -SCALEMOUSE -AFE -ALIEN -BLOOD -ZOMBIE -NOCUTSCENES. 'ScreenSize 0' in data\OPTIONS.TXT is the view size, not a resolution. The only resolution chooser is nGlide's external nglide_config.exe 1.02. Its hardcoded list has index 0 'By app (Default)', 1 'By desktop', 2 '640 x 480' ... 21 '1920 x 1080' ... 28 '7680 x 4320', and the aspect list has 0 'Fit to screen (Default)' and 1 '4 : 3'.
titles.evidence: install.reg [HKLM\SOFTWARE\SCI\Carmageddon2] Driver=2. launch.txt runs Play Carmageddon 2.bat, which starts CARMA2_HW.EXE. nGlide readme 'Version: 1.02' (nglide_config.exe md5 6ab5ef66, glide2x.dll md5 e4867e04). Disassembly of nglide_config.exe: CB_GETCURSEL on combo 0x3ec is stored and written with RegSetValueExA(HKCU 'Software\Zeus Software\nGlide', 'Resolution'/'Aspect', REG_SZ, sprintf('%d', index)). glide2x.dll opens the same key under 0x80000001 (HKCU). PER-TITLE-STATUS says 'incapable (Glide device offers 512x384/640x480/800x600)'; the real limit is the 320x200/640x480 data sets. Evidence: static/nglide102-config-decode.txt, boxes/registry-reads.txt, prior-0831/123_Carmageddon2_Play_Carmageddon_2.png, static/binary-strings.txt
titles.fix: Make nGlide render at the desktop mode with a 4:3 picture. Add to Carmageddon2\install.reg (REGEDIT4): [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Zeus Software\nGlide] "Resolution"="1" (By desktop) and "Aspect"="1" (4 : 3). Both are REG_SZ decimal strings, exactly as nglide_config writes them. Alternatively write them from the launcher with FLEETRES.EXE -reg HKCU "Software\Zeus Software\nGlide" Resolution sz 1 (and Aspect), which also survives someone re-running the configurator. 'By desktop' is per-box by construction: 1920x1080 on the LCDs, the tube's own mode on CRTs, and no effect where FR_GLIDE=1 moves nGlide aside. The game still has no in-game resolution menu. An optional true-widescreen FOV exists: AlphaYellow's 'Carmageddon II FOV Fix' ASI plugin with ThirteenAG's Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput.dll).
titles.fix_source: nGlide 1.02 is already in the tree (Carmageddon2\glide2x.dll and nglide_config.exe). nGlide 2.10 is also on the share at Files\Game Updates\nGlide210_setup.exe (XP support per its readme, subsystem 4.0). The FOV fix would have to be downloaded from community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/2968 (not on the share, searched case-insensitively).
titles.fix_risk: Low, but unverified on hardware. The value encoding is decoded from the configurator binary; confirm it with one run of nglide_config.exe plus REGREAD before staging. The HKCU nGlide key is per user and global, so UnrealGold's game-local nGlide 1.02 reads it too, but only when UE1 is set to GlideDrv (non-3dfx boxes get D3DDrv). A 1080p D3D9 surface is trivial load even on the HD 5450 and 8400GS. The 640x480 2D front end is upscaled and will look softer. LAN (IPXWrapper) is unaffected. The ASI FOV fix is third-party code injected into CARMA2_HW.EXE and is untested on XP.
titles.hw_check: Carmageddon 2's front end ignores agent clicks and keys (compat DB note 'the front end ignores click *and* key'), and there is no resolution menu anyway. On .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Carmageddon2" "Play Carmageddon 2.bat". After about 20 s, DISPLAYCFG get reads 640x480 today; with the nGlide values it should read 1920x1080. SCREENSHOT 0 works on XP for nGlide D3D9 (08-31 captures prove it) and should show content about 1440x1080 at x=240. REGREAD HKCU Software\Zeus Software\nGlide to confirm the values. Then taskkill /f /im "CARMA2_HW.EXE" and confirm the desktop is back at 1920x1080.
titles.verifier_notes: The _patches README notes that the Carmageddon 2 region patch is undetermined. CARMA2_HW.EXE carries 'v1.02a' and a 'Western European version' guard string, which may help identify the edition. It does not bear on resolution.

titles.title: RedneckRampage
titles.engine: Build engine (Xatrix/Interplay), DOS/4GW RR.EXE, ROUTE66M.EXE and AGAIN\RA.EXE (GOG Collection), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 with machine=vesa_nolfb
titles.launch_sets: All seven launchers write fullresolution=%FR_DOSFULLRES% into dosboxRR.conf, which is passed first; the per-game confs are [IPX]/[autoexec] only. The GAMERES rule is at gameres.h:794. REDNECK.CFG and AGAIN\REDNECK.CFG are byte-identical to GOG's own copies and set ScreenMode=1 (VESA 2.0), ScreenWidth=800, ScreenHeight=600. The deployed dosboxRR.conf on all four LCD boxes reads desktop/overlay/aspect=true, so the 800x600 image is scaled to a 1440x1080 pillarbox. Measured on 08-31 on .123: content 1440x1080 at x=240. Present and correct.
titles.menu_source: The in-game menus have no video-mode item. RR.EXE's menu strings are SCREEN SIZE, SCREEN TILTIN', BRIGHTNESS and so on, and it has no 'mode selected' string and no resolution cheat. The game's own SETUP (SETMAIN.EXE, reached through the 'Redneck Rampage - Setup - Network Config' shortcut) offers a HARDCODED list of six VESA modes: 320x200, 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768, 1280x1024 and 1600x1200 ('Set screen width to N pixels and screen height to M pixels', under 'Choose a VESA 1.0/2.0 Mode'). At start RR.EXE checks the chosen mode against the VBE list ('VESA driver for ( %ld * %ld ) not found/supported!'). DOSBox 0.74's emulated S3 VBE offers nothing above 1280x1024 and nothing at 1920x1080.
titles.evidence: Staged files: all 7 .bat files have the FLEETRES -ini dosboxRR.conf line. dosboxRR.conf: fullscreen=true, fullresolution=original (staged literal), output=overlay, machine=vesa_nolfb, aspect=true. REGNECK.CFG md5 matches Games/Installed/RedneckRampage_GOG/REDNECK.CFG. Strings in SETMAIN.EXE and RR.EXE are in static/binary-strings.txt. VESA table: static/dosbox074-vesa-mode-table.txt. Also boxes/<ip>_RedneckRampage__dosboxRR.conf and prior-0831/123_RedneckRampage_Play_Redneck_Rampage_-_Game.png.
titles.fix: None is possible inside the DOS game. SETUP's list has no 1920x1080 entry, DOSBox 0.74's VBE table has none, and the 1990s DOS Build engine caps its framebuffer at 1600x1200 (MAXXDIM/MAXYDIM in Ken Silverman's Build source; this is background knowledge, not checked in this binary). The correct 1080p presentation, DOSBox desktop plus aspect=true, is already deployed. A true 1080p render needs a source port (Raze, NBlood-family Rednukem, or Erampage). None is on the share (searched case-insensitively for raze, nblood, rednukem and eduke32); current builds' XP support is unverified; and a port would replace the DOSBox IPX LAN setup with its own netcode.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: stage-fleetres.py entry and gameres.h:794. A port would have to be downloaded.
titles.fix_risk: None for the recommended no-change answer. A source port would be a new engine, a multiplayer protocol change, and a full re-stage and LAN re-proof.
titles.hw_check: Presentation: on .145, EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\RedneckRampage" "Play Redneck Rampage - Game.bat". DISPLAYCFG get must stay 1920x1080. SCREENSHOT 0 should show content 1440x1080 at x=240 (the 08-31 .123 capture already shows this; the .240 and .246 captures were black). List: 'Redneck Rampage Setup.bat' opens a DOSBox choice prompt; send UIKEY 1. SETUP is a keyboard-navigable text menu (arrows/Enter/Esc). Open Screen Setup, then the VESA mode list, which should show the six fixed modes and no 1920x1080. Leave with Esc WITHOUT saving, because saving rewrites REDNECK.CFG. Kill with taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe".

titles.title: ShadowWarrior
titles.engine: Build engine (3D Realms), the original DOS Shadow Warrior 1.2 (SW.EXE is a copy of SW.DAT, banner 'SHADOW WARRIOR(tm) Version 1.2'; Wanton.dat for Wanton Destruction) from GOG's 'Shadow Warrior Classic Complete', run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74. It is NOT a source port: no Redux, JFSW or VoidSW files in the tree.
titles.launch_sets: All five launchers (the three Play shortcuts plus Host and Join LAN) write fullresolution into dosbox_swarrior.conf, which is passed first; the dosboxSW_*.conf files are [ipx]/[autoexec] only. The GAMERES rule is at gameres.h:798. SW.CFG and dragon\SW.CFG set ScreenMode=2 (Screen Buffered) at 320x200. DEFECT: dosbox_swarrior.conf line 52 has aspect=false, GOG's default, staged unmodified. On the LCDs DOSBox scales 320x200 as square pixels to 1728x1080 (16:10) instead of 1440x1080, so the picture is about 20% too wide. Measured: the 08-31 captures on .123 and on .246 (the Win7 box, now .195) have content 1728x1080 at x=96..1824 (ratio 1.600), and the deployed conf on all four LCD boxes still reads aspect=false (2026-09-29).
titles.menu_source: The Options menu has no resolution item. In game, F5 runs ResChange(), which cycles only the VBE-reported 'approved' modes 320x200, 640x400, 640x480 and 800x600 and prints '%d x %d mode selected.' (that string is in SW.DAT). The 'swres' cheat (also in SW.DAT) runs CheatResChange() over every VBE mode. Both lists come from the emulated VBE via getvalidvesamodes. DOSBox 0.74's S3 VBE offers up to 1280x1024 (plus 1152x864 and 848x480) and no 1920x1080. SETUP (Setmain.exe) hardcodes 320x200, 320x400, 640x480 and 800x600.
titles.evidence: Staged: dosbox_swarrior.conf [sdl] fullresolution=desktop, output=overlay; [render] aspect=false, scaler=normal2x; machine=svga_s3. SW.CFG: 'ScreenMode = 2 / ScreenWidth = 320 / ScreenHeight = 200'. SW.EXE and SW.DAT md5 0c76df2d. The ResChange/CheatResChange logic is the original 3DR code kept (commented out) in jonof/jfsw src/draw.c (static/shadowwarrior-reschange-excerpt.txt). Screenshots: prior-0831/123_ShadowWarrior_Play_Shadow_Warrior.png and 246_ShadowWarrior_Play_Shadow_Warrior.png (1728x1080 content). Configs: boxes/<ip>_ShadowWarrior__dosbox_swarrior.conf. Tables: static/dosbox074-vesa-mode-table.txt.
titles.fix: In-game 1080p is not possible, for the same reasons as Redneck Rampage (the VBE table and the DOS Build framebuffer limit). Aspect defect: set aspect=true. Change 'aspect=false' to 'aspect=true' under [render] in the staged dosbox_swarrior.conf, or append '[render]' and 'aspect=true' to our dosboxSW_sw/_td/_wd/_lan.conf, which are passed last and win per key. On the LCDs the 320x200 image then shows at 1440x1080 like every other DOSBox title. On CRTs (fullresolution=original) DOSBox asks the tube for 640x480 instead of 640x400, which is also correct 4:3. An optional sharper picture: SW.CFG ScreenMode=1 at 640x480 or 800x600, both in the VBE and F5 lists; that is still 4:3.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: one key in Games-Library/ShadowWarrior/dosbox_swarrior.conf, or in our dosboxSW_*.conf. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Very low. With output=overlay the aspect scaling is done in hardware, so there is no CPU cost. The value is right on both LCDs and CRTs, so it can be a staged constant. No LAN impact. It must reach every box through GAMESYNC, which re-copies the conf; GAMERES then rewrites fullresolution.
titles.hw_check: On .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\ShadowWarrior" "Play Shadow Warrior.bat". At the main menu, SCREENSHOT 0: the content box is 1728x1080 at x=96..1824 today and should be 1440x1080 at x=240..1680 after the fix. For the list, start a game (the Build menu is keyboard-navigable with Enter and arrows), press UIKEY F5 several times and capture each '%d x %d mode selected.' message; expect 320x200, 640x400, 640x480, 800x600, then back. Optionally press T, type swres (UIKEY TEXT:swres), then Enter, to cycle all VBE modes; the maximum should be 1280x1024. Whether agent keystrokes reach DOSBox here is unverified. Afterwards run taskkill /f /im "DOSBox.exe" and check the desktop mode.

titles.title: Descent1 - Play Descent.bat (default DOSBox shortcut)
titles.engine: Descent DOS registered v1.4a (DESCENTR.EXE, 'Registered v1.4a May 2, 1995'), run in GOG's DOSBox 0.74 with output=ddraw
titles.launch_sets: The Play, Host LAN, Join LAN and Sound Setup launchers all write fullresolution into dosboxD1.conf, which is passed first. The GAMERES rule is at gameres.h:795. dosboxD1_single.conf runs plain DESCENTR.EXE with no mode switch, so the game renders 320x200. The deployed conf on all four LCD boxes reads desktop/ddraw/aspect=true, which gives a 1440x1080 pillarbox. Measured on 08-31 on .123, .240 and .246 (Win7): content 1439x1080 at x=240. Present and correct.
titles.menu_source: The game's menus have no resolution option. Decoding DESCENT.TXB from DESCENT.HOG shows the options are Detail levels, Brightness, Sound and controls. Resolution is set only by command-line switch: -320x240, -320x400, -640x400, -640x480 and -320x100 are strings in DESCENTR.EXE. The maximum is 640x480 VESA.
titles.evidence: Staged: Play Descent.bat; dosboxD1.conf [sdl] fullresolution=original (staged literal), output=ddraw; aspect=true; dosboxD1_single.conf runs 'DESCENTR.EXE'. DESCENTR.EXE strings are in static/binary-strings.txt. Screenshot: prior-0831/123_Descent1_Play_Descent.png. Config: boxes/<ip>_Descent1__dosboxD1.conf.
titles.fix: None is possible in this engine: its ceiling is 640x480 and DOSBox's VBE tops out at 1280x1024. The tree's 1080p path is the Rebirth shortcut (next entry). An optional sharper picture: add -640x480 to DESCENTR.EXE in dosboxD1_single.conf (640x480 VESA is in DOSBox's table). That is still 4:3 and is unverified.
titles.hw_check: This is already measured on three LCD boxes. To complete .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent1" "Play Descent.bat". DISPLAYCFG get stays 1920x1080, and SCREENSHOT content should be about 1440x1080. The DOS menus are keyboard-navigable but have no resolution item to show.

titles.title: Descent1 - Play Descent - Rebirth.bat (D1X-Rebirth)
titles.engine: D1X-Rebirth v0.58.1 (32-bit, OpenGL, SDL 1.2 windib, fetched 2026-08-29 from dxx-rebirth.com)
titles.launch_sets: The launcher writes the size with FLEETRES.EXE -kv DESCENT.CFG ResolutionX %FR_W% / ResolutionY %FR_H%. The GAMERES rule at gameres.h:782-783 mirrors it. The game then opens 1920x1080 fullscreen (WindowMode defaults to 0). The deployed DESCENT.CFG on .123/.145/.195/.240 has ResolutionX=1920 and ResolutionY=1080 but NO AspectX or AspectY lines. The config.c defaults therefore apply: AspectX=3, AspectY=4. gr_set_mode computes sc_aspect = (1920*3)/(1080*4) = 1.333, so g3_start_frame scales x by 0.75, exactly as at 640x480. The result is a 4:3 3D projection stretched 1.33x across the 16:9 panel. 2D art (title, menu backgrounds, fonts) is also stretched by design, because show_fullscr scales to the full canvas. The pixel count is right; the geometry is wrong.
titles.menu_source: Options... > 'Screen resolution...' (change_res() in 0.58.1 menu.c). The radio list comes from gr_list_modes(), which calls SDL_ListModes(NULL, SDL_OPENGL|SDL_FULLSCREEN): driver-enumerated, largest first, at most 50 entries, nothing below 320x200. The menu also has 'use custom values' with 'resolution:' and 'aspect:' input fields, and a Fullscreen checkbox. All four LCD drivers enumerate 1920x1080@60 (GAMERES mode lists, 2026-09-29). Choosing a preset also sets AspectY=W/gcd and AspectX=H/gcd, which gives 16/9.
titles.evidence: Strings in d1x-rebirth.exe: 'D1X-Rebirth v0.58.1', 'descent.cfg', 'ResolutionX', 'ResolutionY', 'AspectX', 'AspectY', 'Screen resolution...', 'use custom values'. Source at tag 0.58.1-d1x: config.c defaults AspectX=3/AspectY=4; arch/ogl/gr.c:640 computes sc_aspect; 3d/setup.c:50; menu.c:944-958; gr_list_modes (static/dxx-rebirth-0.58.1-aspect-excerpts.txt). On Windows the PhysFS write directory is the exe's directory, so this is the same DESCENT.CFG the DOS build uses. Evidence: boxes/<ip>_Descent1__DESCENT.CFG and boxes/<ip>-GAMERES.txt.
titles.fix: Write the aspect alongside the resolution, in the engine's own counter-intuitive convention: AspectY = W/gcd(W,H) and AspectX = H/gcd(W,H). For 1920x1080 that is AspectX=9 and AspectY=16, not 16 and 9; swapped values give sc_aspect 3.16. 4:3 targets get 3 and 4. For example: FLEETRES.EXE -kv DESCENT.CFG AspectX 9, and the same for AspectY 16. Drive it from a new FR_ASPW/FR_ASPH pair in FLEETRES -cmd, or from a cmd branch on %FR_ASPECT%==16:9. Add matching GR_OP_KV rows to gameres.h with new %ASPW%/%ASPH% tokens. The 2D stretch remains; that is a 0.58.1 limitation.
titles.fix_source: The engine side is already in the tree: d1x-rebirth.exe reads AspectX/AspectY. The change goes in scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (the Descent1 kv_cfg pairs), agent/shared/gameres.h (rules and a new token), provisioning/fleetres/fleetres.c if FR_ASPW/FR_ASPH are added, and tests/python/test_gameres_mirror.py. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low: this only changes the client-side projection, and UDP LAN is unaffected. There is a pre-existing hazard: Descent1's DESCENT.CFG is SHARED with the DOS build, and D1X's WriteConfigFile rewrites it on exit with only its own keys. That drops the DOS build's staged DigiDeviceID=0xe016 sound answer until the next GAMESYNC re-copies the staged file. The deployed files still carry the DOS keys, so Rebirth has not exited on these boxes since the last sync.
titles.hw_check: Use .145 or .240; on 08-31 the OpenGL fullscreen capture was black on .123 and fine on .240. EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent1" "Play Descent - Rebirth.bat". WINLIST should show an SDL window at 0,0 sized 1920x1080. The menus are keyboard-navigable with arrows, Enter and Esc: Esc past the intro, then Options... > Screen resolution..., SCREENSHOT the list (expect 1920x1080 at the top), then Esc without changing anything. In flight, take a SCREENSHOT; if it is black, UIKEY PRINTSCREEN makes DXX write screenshots\scrnNNNN, which can be fetched with DOWNLOAD. Compare round objects and the reticle before and after the aspect fix. Finally DOWNLOAD C:\Games\Descent1\DESCENT.CFG to read AspectX/AspectY.

titles.title: Descent2 - Play Descent 2.bat and the Host/Join LAN launchers (D2X-Rebirth, default)
titles.engine: D2X-Rebirth v0.58.1 (32-bit, OpenGL, SDL 1.2 windib; same SDL.dll as Descent1, md5 3ea78295)
titles.launch_sets: Play, Host LAN and Join LAN all write the size with FLEETRES -kv DESCENT.CFG ResolutionX %FR_W% / ResolutionY %FR_H%. The GAMERES rule at gameres.h:784-785 mirrors it. The game opens 1920x1080 fullscreen. The deployed DESCENT.CFG on all four LCD boxes has ResolutionX=1920 and ResolutionY=1080 and no AspectX or AspectY. The d2x config.c defaults of 3 and 4 apply, so this is the same 4:3-projection-stretched-to-16:9 result as D1X; the code is identical (arch/ogl/gr.c:643). On 08-31 a mode change to 1920x1080 was recorded on .123, .240 and .246. The .240 capture shows the 640x480 Parallax title art stretched to 1776x936, which is 2D stretch by design. The in-flight 3D view has never been captured.
titles.menu_source: Same as D1X. Options... (5th item) > 'Screen resolution...' gives a driver-enumerated SDL_ListModes list, largest first, at most 50 entries, plus 'use custom values' with resolution and aspect fields. 1920x1080@60 is enumerated on all four LCD boxes.
titles.evidence: Strings in d2x-rebirth.exe: 'D2X-Rebirth v0.58.1', 'descent.cfg', 'AspectX', 'AspectY', 'Screen resolution...', 'use custom values'. Source at tag 0.58.1-d2x: config.c:105-108 sets the defaults 640x480 with AspectX=3 and AspectY=4. The staged DESCENT.CFG is the Win95 build's own file (DigiDeviceID8..., VR_resolution=0) with no Rebirth keys. Evidence: boxes/<ip>_Descent2__DESCENT.CFG and prior-0831/240_Descent2_Play_Descent_2.png.
titles.fix: Same as Descent1 Rebirth: add AspectX=H/gcd and AspectY=W/gcd (for 1920x1080, AspectX=9 and AspectY=16) through FLEETRES -kv in Play, Host and Join, plus GR_OP_KV rows in gameres.h. The 2D title and menu stretch remains.
titles.fix_source: The engine side is already in the tree. Change stage-fleetres.py (the Descent2 entry, plus whatever generates the Host/Join LAN launchers), gameres.h and test_gameres_mirror.py. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low: client-side only, and UDP 42424 LAN is unaffected. Descent2's DESCENT.CFG is also read by the Win95 DESCENTW.EXE, which ignores unknown keys.
titles.hw_check: On .240 or .145: EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent2" "Play Descent 2.bat", Esc past the intro movies, then use the keyboard-navigable menu: Options... > Screen resolution... and SCREENSHOT the list, which should show 1920x1080. Esc out. Start a level, then take a SCREENSHOT or use PRINTSCREEN and DOWNLOAD the screenshot from screenshots\. Check that a round reticle or robot is not 1.33x wide. On Win7 .195 GDI capture is black, so use DISPLAYCFG and WINLIST there, or the in-game screenshot.

titles.title: Descent2 - Play Descent 2 - original Win95.bat (DESCENTW.EXE)
titles.engine: Descent II Win95 DirectDraw build (DESCENTW.EXE md5 93735643), started behind the resilient disc-mount launcher (d2disc.iso)
titles.launch_sets: FLEETRES and GAMERES are not involved; the generated mount launcher has no FLEETRES block. DESCENTW.EXE sets its own DirectDraw mode from its Screen resolution choice, 800x600 at most. On a 1080p panel the display switches down and the panel scales it. The shortcut needs the disc_mount capability. This is the fallback path, not the default.
titles.menu_source: Options > 'Screen resolution...' opens the 'Select screen mode' dialog with a hardcoded list in DESCENTW.EXE: ' 320x200', ' 640x480', 'Modes w/o Cockpit:', ' 640x400', ' 800x600'. It can also say 'Mode not supported by your DirectDraw driver'.
titles.evidence: DESCENTW.EXE strings near offset line 15285 (static/binary-strings.txt). 'Play Descent 2 - original Win95.bat' has GAME=%~dp0DESCENTW.EXE and no FLEETRES line.
titles.fix: None is possible for this binary: the list is hardcoded with an 800x600 maximum. The 1080p path is the default Rebirth shortcut. Descent II's official 1.2 patch is not a resolution change, and it was deliberately not applied per _patches/README.txt.
titles.hw_check: Optional. On a box with a disc mounter, start the shortcut; the Descent menu is keyboard-navigable. Go to Options > Screen resolution... and screenshot the four-entry list. DirectDraw exclusive mode may capture black.

titles.title: Descent3
titles.engine: Descent 3 1.4.0 (the official 1.4 no-CD file set from descent3.com; main.exe md5 61db25d7, 1,789,952 B), Direct3D renderer (install.reg PreferredRenderer=3)
titles.launch_sets: Play Descent 3.bat runs start "" main.exe -launched -Width %FR_W% -Height %FR_H%; the Join LAN launcher also passes -Width/-Height, and Host is the dedicated server. In init.cpp, -Width and -Height overwrite the hidden 8th Video_res_list slot and select it, which gives 1920x1080 on the LCDs; the README says 'if possible'. No -aspect is passed. rend_GetAspectRatio()/d3d_GetAspectRatio() return 3W/4H, which assumes a 4:3 monitor, so g3_StartFrame scales exactly as at 640x480: a 4:3 projection stretched to 16:9. The in-game mode has NEVER actually been observed. On 08-31 the 640x480 rows on .123 and .246 were the intro movie (the Dolby Surround logo). The .240 '1920x1080 verified' row is a picture of the desktop: Descent 3 is in the taskbar, and a SeriousSam error dialog is showing.
titles.menu_source: Options > Video > Resolution has seven hardcoded radio buttons. Their labels are strings in main.exe 1.4: 512x384, 640x480, 800x600, 960x720, 1024x768, 1280x960, 1600x1200 (Video_res_list in config.cpp). The 8th 'custom' slot is reachable only through -Width/-Height and has no button; when the game is launched that way, no button is checked.
titles.evidence: main.exe strings: the seven labels at lines 10449-10455, 'RS_resolution', '-Height', '-Width', '-aspect'. The staged Descent3\language\readmes\README.TXT documents '-width <width> ... if possible' and '-aspect <value> ... on a 16:9 wide-screen TV, use "-aspect 1.78"'. The 2024 source release (DescentDevelopers/Descent3 @ df209742) has config.cpp's Video_res_list and menu, init.cpp's -Width/-Height/-aspect handling, HardwareSetup.cpp's g3_StartFrame, and Direct3D.cpp's d3d_GetAspectRatio (static/descent3-aspect-excerpts.txt). Captures: prior-0831/123_Descent3_Play_Descent_3.png (Dolby logo at 640x480) and 240_Descent3_Play_Descent_3.png (desktop).
titles.fix: The in-game list cannot be changed with the 1.4 binary; its labels are compiled in. The open-source Descent3 v1.5.0 builds its list from the display modes, but its only Windows build is x64 (Descent3_Release_Windows-x64.zip), so it cannot run on the 32-bit XP boxes. For the launch geometry, add the vendor-documented switch to both client launchers. For example: set D3ASP= then if "%FR_ASPECT%"=="16:9" set D3ASP=-aspect 1.78 (use 1.6 for 16:10), then start main.exe -launched -Width %FR_W% -Height %FR_H% %D3ASP%. This title is command-line only, so by design it needs no gameres.h rule.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: main.exe 1.4 supports -aspect, and the staged README.TXT lines 992-997 document it. Change the stage-fleetres.py 'Descent3' entry and the generator of 'Join Descent 3 - LAN.bat'. No download.
titles.fix_risk: Low: this only changes the client-side projection. Multiplayer and the dedicated server are unaffected. The 2D HUD and cockpit stay 640x480-scaled, so they remain stretched. Separately, nobody has yet confirmed that the D3D renderer accepts 1920x1080 on the HD 3850, 8400GS, HD 5450 and X800, because the 08-31 sweep never captured the game itself.
titles.hw_check: The menus CANNOT be driven by the agent: README-FLEET says the exclusive surface ignores synthetic input, and requires.json calls it a relative-mouse menu. Viewing Options > Video (expect the seven fixed 4:3 entries) needs a human. What the agent can check: on .145 (XP), EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Descent3" "Play Descent 3.bat", then wait past the 640x480 intro movies until Pilot Training renders, about 90 s. DISPLAYCFG get, and WINLIST for main.exe, must show 1920x1080. SCREENSHOT 0 works on XP (it captured the movie on 08-31); check whether the reticle and round cockpit elements are stretched. Repeat after adding -aspect 1.78 and compare. Then taskkill /f /im "main.exe".
titles.verifier_notes: requires.json still declares a title-level requires_capabilities disc_mount with the note 'The launcher mounts a disc image'. That has been stale since the 1.4 no-CD set was applied. The shortcuts are nevertheless present on .123, .145 and .240 (All Users desktop listing, 2026-09-29).
